luiskr.com / core/utils/motion/spring / springStep

function springStep(s, k, c, dt, epsSettle?, epsVel?): void

Defined in: core/utils/motion/spring.ts:41

Advances one integration step: accelerates toward targetP under stiffness k and damping c, then snaps to the stop once both the gap and the velocity fall under the settle epsilons — without the snap an underdamped spring rings sub-pixel forever.

Parameters

s

SpringChase

The chase state — mutated in place (zero allocation).

k

number

c

number

Spring damping (2ζωn).

dt

number

Integration step in seconds (clamped upstream).

epsSettle?

number = SLIDER_SPRING.SETTLE_EPS

Settle epsilon in the state's units — the slider widgets' normalized default; px-space callers (scroll spring) pass their own.

epsVel?

number = SLIDER_SPRING.VEL_EPS

Velocity settle epsilon (state units/s) — see epsSettle.
